categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through early or timely payment without enforcement actions. Advances Maximize timely fine revenue and minimizes administrative costs, measured against indicator Time to fine dispatch.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=12. Supported by variants like V0002 and V0007 where payment occurs shortly after fine creation.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through payment occurring after penalties or enforcement steps have been initiated. Advances timely fine revenue, measured against average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=13. Supported by variants like V0004, V0005, and V0006 where payments happen after notifications and penalties.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture. Preserves due process rights while impacting administrative costs, measured against time to appeal filing, Prefecture.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=14. Supported by variants like V0008 and V0057 containing administrative appeal activities.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through a judicial appeal to a judge. Heavily favors due process rights and is measured against time to appeal filing, Judge.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=19. Supported by variants like V0103 and V0176 showing explicit judicial appeal handling.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through coercive credit collection steps when all prior attempts have failed. Maximizes revenue at the cost of administrative expenses and offender rights, measured against average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=20. Supported by frequent high-duration variants such as V0001 and V0009 culminating in credit collection dispatch.
